entries.title: AI-Led GTM Reinvention: The OAR Matrix and the Four Buying Lanes
entries.audience: GTM leader, RevOps leader, VP of Sales, CMO
entries.summary: The standard SaaS GTM playbook was built for 2018 and is structurally broken for 2026. The OAR Matrix (Optimize, Amplify, Reinvent) helps GTM leaders place AI correctly, and 75% of deal friction is internal — not from buyers. Within 18 months, every company will land in one of four buying lanes ranging from human-only to AI-to-AI.

entries.title: More Data Isn't Creating More Clarity
entries.audience: GTM leader, RevOps leader, VP of Sales, CRO
entries.summary: GTM teams aren't struggling from lack of data — they're struggling because signal interpretation is fragmenting faster than orgs can coordinate. AI-referred buyers arrive pre-educated before entering any observable funnel. Efficient growth comes from system alignment, not activity volume.
